notes.title: Update to version v0.5.4b
notes.content: - Fixed the crash that occurred when trying to access the property of an object when it was a null object.

notes.title: Update to version v0.5.3b
notes.content:
- Fixed the error that crashes the game due to an overflow in the console buffer.
- The game adds an error.log file in the installation directory when a crash error occurs reporting the cause of that error (useful to send it to the dev for more information about a crash error).

notes.title: Update to version v0.5.2b
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729839/9d5f1f989a8c22d7e76b16505d10854d10edf9eb.jpg[/img]
This update comes with the following changes:

- The main menu is added to the title screen where you can select the language, adjust the difficulty, or adjust the game's sound volume.

- The language, difficulty, and volume commands are removed from the command console as they can now be adjusted from the main menu (before starting a new game).

- The menu is localized into the 7 available languages.

- The font size in the command console is corrected so that the bottom part of the letters and other symbols can now be seen.

With this version, the game advances to 52% of its development. Happy Halloween to everyone!

notes.title: Update to version v0.5.1b
notes.content:
The new update to version v0.5.1b brings with it the following changes:

- It is now possible to pause the game by pressing the ESCAPE key, so pressing it will no longer exit the game directly as before.
- Extra instructions have been added to the text at the top left of the screen in order to tell the user how to scroll in the command console.
- Warnings related to photosensitive health, stress, and game still in development have been added to the 'How to Play' screen prior to starting the game.
- Some minor errors that have been detected have been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: New hotfix to solve the crash when using the "look" command in the great hall and in the kitchen.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
- Hotfix to solve a bug that caused you to abruptly exit the game when pressing Enter in the stairs sequence.
- Realigned the font for languages ​​with a Western alphabet.
- Optimized the function that prints characters in the command console in order to improve game performance.

notes.title: Great update to version v0.5.0b!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729839/548a83afc38d2824806fea6c5516b83e6fd3acee.jpg[/img]
I am pleased to announce this great new update to version v0.5.0b, which is undoubtedly a big leap forward that I hope will make you enjoy the game like never before.

The new features are as follows:

- New, smaller, stylized command console with scroll! Now you can use the 'Page Up' and 'Page Down' keys to scroll up or down as many times as you want.

- New in-game popup window to show the object being checked more closely (not all objects are available in this window yet, but they will be included in future updates).

- New visual effects to enhance the experience and immersion:

     + Electrocardiogram effect to visually display the heartbeat, complementing the existing sound effect.

     + Bleeding effect when "dying".

     + Grayscale fade effect when "dying".

- Added two new languages: Simplified Chinese and Japanese!

- Fixed some of the bugs detected. Thank you very much for your feedback!

With this new update, the game reaches the halfway point of its development, with another 50% still to come. Thank you very much for your patience, understanding, and trust. I will continue to work to offer you an even better product.

Good game to all!

notes.title: New Brazilian Portuguese language available and new visual effects!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729839/4e4e9257df0553abb871a56de451912e233ef1e5.png[/img]
- New Brazilian Portuguese language available using the [brazilian language] command.
- New darkness and flashlight visual effects to give a greater atmosphere of suspense and tension.
- Added a second key that opens another initially closed room.
- Fixed some minor errors detected.

notes.title: New key system and locked doors in the new update
notes.content:
- New system of keys and closed doors, apart from the clues, which improves the fun and depth of the game.
- Change in the text of the initial intro to add some more context to the player. 
- Replaced the '_' symbol with the '-' symbol in the entity name in order to make it easier to type.
- Corrected duplicate texts in 'How to play'.
- Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Update to version v0.4.7b
notes.content:
- New improved fog visual effect for a greater atmosphere of mystery.
- Applied some minor corrections.

notes.title: German language now available in the new v0.4.6b update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729839/d453bd1c7decf4b9bc5484f2e2a9be732115e7bf.png[/img]

New update to version v0.4.6b with the following changes, improvements and addition of content:

- New German language available selectable with the [language german] command.
- Corrected line breaks in new languages.
- Fixed the hidden word challenge whose word did not appear after adding the new languages.
- Corrected the positions of some texts in the new languages ​​on the 'How to play' screen.
- Corrected the position of the 'Press Enter to play' text in new languages.
- Fixed some minor bugs.

More languages ​​and some visual improvements will be available soon. Thank you for your patience and trust.

notes.title: French language now available in the new v0.4.5b update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729839/bee3420d65c0bc94d3115491cb9b959cffb6ef1a.png[/img]

New update to version v0.4.5b with the following changes, improvements and addition of content:

- New French language available selectable with the [language french] command.
- Adjusted the game engine to support new languages.
- Fixed some minor bugs.

German and Italian languages ​​will also be available soon. Thank you for your patience and trust.

notes.title: New Scarecrow killer with v0.4.4b update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729839/fbc7aa5e2db1c189e6b07cd137bee1fba6b6cfb1.png[/img]

New content update that adds a new killer to the cast of antagonists. Can you escape the fearsome Scarecrow?

- New killer: Scarecrow.
- Fixed the problem of the game suddenly exiting when the killer appears on some occasions.
- Other small corrections applied that have been detected.

notes.title: Update to version v0.4.3b
